name: frost-survives-tab-switch-shadow-resize
description: the production frost's four survival properties in one reveal - a tab switch (forces SortSubviews), the devbar's overlay shadow up at the same time (both are unassociated NSViews sharing contentView, so their overlap band near x=227..268 y=38..90 at this window's geometry is where a bad insertion order would show), and a window resize (the panel's own ApplyBounds/OnWidgetBoundsChanged tracking path). Analysis is offline pixcmp on the pulled frames, not JSON assertions - this is an investigative measurement, not yet a committed regression.
